description: Contract check schemas with binding targets, required_fields, and request_templates for systematic verification of PLAN.md contract sections

contract_checks.name: Limit Recovery

request_template.observable: The physical observable being tested in the limit (e.g., 'scattering amplitude at E→0')
request_template.claim: The asserted limit behavior from PLAN.md (e.g., 'amplitude → 0 as E→0')
request_template.deliverable: The computed/artifact expression to test (e.g., 'M(E) = g^2 * E / (E^2 + m^2)')

contract_checks.verification_method: Compute limit of deliverable using limiting_case_check.py; compare against claimed behavior; check acceptance_test threshold

contract_checks.name: Benchmark Reproduction
contract_checks.verification_method: Substitute numerical values from reference into deliverable; compare against claimed value within acceptance_test tolerance

contract_checks.name: Direct-Proxy Consistency

request_template.claim: Claim about direct-proxy relationship (e.g., 'proxy ≈ direct within 5%')
request_template.deliverable: Both direct and proxy computation results (e.g., 'direct=0.95, proxy=0.93')
request_template.forbidden_proxy: List of proxy types that must NOT be used as sole evidence (e.g., ['perturbative approximation for non-perturbative regime'])

contract_checks.verification_method: Compare direct measurement against proxy; verify no forbidden proxy is sole evidence source; check acceptance_test criterion

contract_checks.name: Fit Family Mismatch

request_template.observable: The quantity being fit/extrapolated (e.g., 'cross section σ(E)')
request_template.claim: The claimed fit family (e.g., 'power-law: σ ~ E^(-2)')
request_template.deliverable: The fit result and family used (e.g., 'fitted as exponential: σ = A*exp(-E)')
request_template.acceptance_test: Family agreement criterion (e.g., 'power-law exponent within ±0.1 of -2')

contract_checks.verification_method: Compare deliverable's fit family against claimed family; test extrapolation behavior; verify acceptance_test

contract_checks.name: Estimator Family Mismatch

request_template.observable: The quantity being estimated (e.g., 'mass gap Δ')
request_template.claim: The claimed estimator properties (e.g., 'unbiased estimator with variance < 0.1')
request_template.deliverable: The estimator result and bias analysis (e.g., 'estimated Δ=0.45 with bias=0.02')

contract_checks.verification_method: Compute estimator bias numerically; check against claimed properties; verify acceptance_test

contract_checks.name: Proof Hypothesis Coverage

request_template.observable: The mathematical object under proof (e.g., 'theorem T')
request_template.claim: Set of hypotheses stated (e.g., 'H1: f continuous, H2: f bounded, H3: domain compact')
request_template.deliverable: The proof text/logic addressing each hypothesis
request_template.acceptance_test: Coverage completeness criterion (e.g., 'all hypotheses explicitly referenced')

contract_checks.verification_method: Enumerate all hypotheses from claim; verify each is addressed in deliverable; check acceptance_test completeness

contract_checks.name: Proof Parameter Coverage

request_template.observable: The parameterized object under proof (e.g., 'P(α, β, γ)')
request_template.acceptance_test: Parameter coverage criterion (e.g., 'all parameter ranges explicitly handled')

contract_checks.verification_method: Enumerate all parameter ranges from claim; verify each range is covered in deliverable; check acceptance_test

contract_checks.name: Proof Quantifier Domain

request_template.acceptance_test: Domain matching criterion (e.g., 'proof domain = claim domain')

contract_checks.verification_method: Extract quantifier domains from claim; verify proof covers same domains; check acceptance_test

contract_checks.name: Claim-to-Proof Alignment

request_template.observable: The target of the claim (e.g., 'scattering amplitude M(s,t)')
request_template.claim: The precise claim statement (e.g., 'M is analytic in s for fixed t')
request_template.deliverable: The proof result (e.g., 'proof of analyticity in complex s-plane')
request_template.acceptance_test: Alignment criterion (e.g., 'proof scope exactly matches claim scope')

contract_checks.verification_method: Compare claim scope against proof scope; verify proof addresses exactly what claim asserts; check acceptance_test

contract_checks.name: Counterexample Search

request_template.observable: The claimed property/theorem (e.g., 'f(x) > 0 for all x ∈ D')
request_template.claim: The universal or existential claim (e.g., '∀x ∈ [0,1]: f(x) ≥ ε')
request_template.deliverable: The claimed result artifact (e.g., 'f(x) computed numerically for 1000 points')
request_template.acceptance_test: No-counterexample criterion (e.g., 'no x found where f(x) < ε')

contract_checks.verification_method: Systematically search for counterexamples using numerical spot-check at boundary values; verify no counterexample found within acceptance_test scope
